issues.detail: Hebrew 'פְּנֵי יְהוָה' means 'the face of the LORD' (i.e., the LORD's presence/anger), but Vietnamese renders it as 'Sự tức giận của Đức Giê-hô-va' ('the anger of the LORD'), which adds a specific emotion not in the Hebrew. The Hebrew simply says 'the face of the LORD' without specifying anger.
